{
  "summary": "Implement the triage.sh script to parse logs, filter only ERROR lines, extract stable error signatures by removing variable fields (orderId, sku, code, providerTxnId, email), count occurrences, and output sorted results in 'count signature' format.",
  "files": [
    {
      "path": "scripts/triage.sh",
      "content": "#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

if [[ $# -lt 1 ]]; then
  echo "Usage: $0 <logfile>" >&2
  exit 1
fi

logfile="$1"

# Filter ERROR lines, strip timestamp and level, then normalize variable fields
# to produce stable signatures, then count and sort.
grep ' ERROR ' "$logfile" \
  | sed 's/^[^ ]* [^ ]* //' \
  | sed -E 's/ orderId=[^ ]*//g; s/ sku=[^ ]*//g; s/ code=[^ ]*//g; s/ providerTxnId=[^ ]*//g; s/ email=[^ ]*//g' \
  | sort \
  | uniq -c \
  | sort -rn \
  | sed 's/^ *//' \
  | while read -r count signature; do
    echo "$count $signature"
  done
"
    }
  ]
}
